subject: Workplace Skills
title: The Bottom Line Up Front
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Bottom Line Up Front.

hook.text: Military officers use BLUF: Bottom Line Up Front. The most important sentence comes first.

buildup.text: Most people bury their request in the third paragraph. Busy readers never get there.

discovery.text: State your ask or conclusion in the first line. Then provide context for those who need it.

twist.text: BLUF feels blunt at first but actually respects the reader's time more than padding does.

climax.text: The reader decides in five seconds whether to act, read more, or archive your message.

punchline.text: Lead with the ask. Context follows for those who need it.

quiz.question: What does BLUF stand for in communication?
